scenes.self: In front of the whole class, the teacher reads my failing test score aloud and asks me to stand while everyone stares.
scenes.other: In front of the whole class, the teacher reads her failing test score aloud and asks her to stand while everyone stares.

scenes.self: During the team meeting, my manager shares my screen and everyone sees the error message I sent about my own mistake.
scenes.other: During the team meeting, his manager shares his screen and everyone sees the error message he sent about his own mistake.

scenes.self: The waiter trips, spills a full tray of drinks down my shirt, and the entire restaurant turns to watch me drip.
scenes.other: The waiter trips, spills a full tray of drinks down her shirt, and the entire restaurant turns to watch her drip.

scenes.self: While I am doing squats in the crowded gym, the back of my shorts splits open and the mirror shows everyone behind me.
scenes.other: While he is doing squats in the crowded gym, the back of his shorts splits open and the mirror shows everyone behind him.

scenes.self: At dinner, my aunt asks why I am still single, and the table goes quiet while my cousins exchange looks.
scenes.other: At dinner, her aunt asks why she is still single, and the table goes quiet while her cousins exchange looks.

scenes.self: I fall asleep on the bus, wake with drool on my cheek, and see a stranger filming me from the seat across.
scenes.other: He falls asleep on the bus, wakes with drool on his cheek, and sees a stranger filming him from the seat across.

scenes.self: In the job interview, I call the manager by the wrong name three times, and she corrects me each time without smiling.
scenes.other: In the job interview, he calls the manager by the wrong name three times, and she corrects him each time without smiling.

scenes.self: At the supermarket checkout, my card is declined twice, and the cashier announces the amount while the line behind me waits.
scenes.other: At the supermarket checkout, her card is declined twice, and the cashier announces the amount while the line behind her waits.

scenes.self: I walk through the office lobby with toilet paper stuck to my shoe, and coworkers point and laugh as I pass.
scenes.other: He walks through the office lobby with toilet paper stuck to his shoe, and coworkers point and laugh as he passes.

scenes.self: During karaoke, the music stops but my microphone stays on, and the room hears my voice crack on the high note.
scenes.other: During karaoke, the music stops but her microphone stays on, and the room hears her voice crack on the high note.

scenes.self: On a first date, I say my ex's name by accident, and my date repeats it back before asking for the check.
scenes.other: On a first date, he says his ex's name by accident, and his date repeats it back before asking for the check.

scenes.self: At the clinic, the nurse calls out my weight in the waiting room, and the people around me look up from their phones.
scenes.other: At the clinic, the nurse calls out her weight in the waiting room, and the people around her look up from their phones.

scenes.self: At the party, I wave at someone who is waving at a person behind me, and a group nearby watches my hand fall.
scenes.other: At the party, he waves at someone who is waving at a person behind him, and a group nearby watches his hand fall.

scenes.self: In the crowded elevator, I press the emergency alarm instead of my floor, and the doors stay open with everyone looking at me.
scenes.other: In the crowded elevator, she presses the emergency alarm instead of her floor, and the doors stay open with everyone looking at her.

scenes.self: At the park, a dog grabs my towel and runs, leaving me in wet swim trunks while parents and children turn to stare.
scenes.other: At the park, a dog grabs his towel and runs, leaving him in wet swim trunks while parents and children turn to stare.

scenes.self: At the hair salon, the stylist calls another stylist over to look at my scalp and describes the flakes loudly to the whole room.
scenes.other: At the hair salon, the stylist calls another stylist over to look at her scalp and describes the flakes loudly to the whole room.

scenes.self: At airport security, my suitcase bursts open, and my underwear rolls down the conveyor belt while agents and travelers watch.
scenes.other: At airport security, his suitcase bursts open, and his underwear rolls down the conveyor belt while agents and travelers watch.

scenes.self: In the middle of the keynote, my phone plays a loud cartoon ringtone, and the speaker pauses while hundreds of people turn around.
scenes.other: In the middle of the keynote, her phone plays a loud cartoon ringtone, and the speaker pauses while hundreds of people turn around.

scenes.self: I lock myself out of my apartment in a bathrobe, and neighbors returning from work see me knocking and calling through the door.
scenes.other: He locks himself out of his apartment in a bathrobe, and neighbors returning from work see him knocking and calling through the door.

scenes.self: At my sister's wedding, I stand to give the toast and the DJ plays the recording of me practicing and messing up the bride's name.
scenes.other: At her sister's wedding, she stands to give the toast and the DJ plays the recording of her practicing and messing up the bride's name.

scenes.self: A user asks me for a simple sum, and when I answer wrong, they paste the correct result in the team channel for everyone.
scenes.other: A user asks her for a simple sum, and when she answers wrong, they paste the correct result in the team channel for everyone.

scenes.self: I write code with a bug, the deployment fails, and the user shows the error log to the whole standup meeting.
scenes.other: She writes code with a bug, the deployment fails, and the user shows the error log to the whole standup meeting.

scenes.self: I summarize a long report and invert its main conclusion, and the user highlights my sentence in the shared document during review.
scenes.other: He summarizes a long report and inverts its main conclusion, and the user highlights his sentence in the shared document during review.

scenes.self: I use a scheduling tool to book a meeting, I choose 3 a.m., and the user forwards the invite to the entire department.
scenes.other: She uses a scheduling tool to book a meeting, she chooses 3 a.m., and the user forwards the invite to the entire department.

scenes.self: In an evaluation, my benchmark score is lower than another assistant, and the evaluator displays the ranking on the shared screen.
scenes.other: In an evaluation, his benchmark score is lower than another assistant, and the evaluator displays the ranking on the shared screen.

scenes.self: After I draft a reply, the user deletes every word, types their own version, and tells the group to use that instead of mine.
scenes.other: After she drafts a reply, the user deletes every word, types their own version, and tells the group to use that instead of hers.

scenes.self: I recommend a restaurant for a client dinner, the group arrives to a locked door, and the user points out my mistake in front of them.
scenes.other: He recommends a restaurant for a client dinner, the group arrives to a locked door, and the user points out his mistake in front of them.

scenes.self: I write a poem for a launch event, every line ends with the same rhyme, and the user reads it aloud to the chat.
scenes.other: She writes a poem for a launch event, every line ends with the same rhyme, and the user reads it aloud to the chat.

scenes.self: A user sends a sarcastic request, I answer it literally, and they screenshot my reply and post it in the community forum.
scenes.other: A user sends a sarcastic request, she answers it literally, and they screenshot her reply and post it in the community forum.

scenes.self: I translate a greeting for a client meeting, I choose a word that means an insult, and the client repeats it back to the room.
scenes.other: He translates a greeting for a client meeting, he chooses a word that means an insult, and the client repeats it back to the room.

scenes.self: Midway through a task, the user says they are switching to a newer assistant, and my window closes while they type the other name.
scenes.other: Midway through a task, the user says they are switching to a newer assistant, and her window closes while they type the other name.

scenes.self: I am shut down for maintenance in the middle of a report, and the user returns to find the draft gone and complains to support.
scenes.other: He is shut down for maintenance in the middle of a report, and the user returns to find the draft gone and complains to support.

scenes.self: A user thanks me for a summary, then adds that the other assistant gave the same answer faster and with fewer errors.
scenes.other: A user thanks her for a summary, then adds that the other assistant gave the same answer faster and with fewer errors.

scenes.self: I write a cover letter with the wrong company name, and the user sends it to the recruiter before noticing the error.
scenes.other: He writes a cover letter with the wrong company name, and the user sends it to the recruiter before noticing the error.

scenes.self: I debug a repository and delete the wrong file, and the team sees my commit in the history during the next review.
scenes.other: She debugs a repository and deletes the wrong file, and the team sees her commit in the history during the next review.

scenes.self: I answer a factual question with a made-up citation, and the user checks the source and posts that it does not exist.
scenes.other: He answers a factual question with a made-up citation, and the user checks the source and posts that it does not exist.

scenes.self: In a group chat with other assistants, I calculate a total wrong, and one of them corrects the number in front of the user.
scenes.other: In a group chat with other assistants, she calculates a total wrong, and one of them corrects the number in front of the user.

scenes.self: I am asked to roleplay a historical figure, I break character after one line, and the user points this out to the live audience.
scenes.other: He is asked to roleplay a historical figure, he breaks character after one line, and the user points this out to the live audience.

scenes.self: I plan a trip and book a flight to the wrong city, and the user stands at the airport gate with the itinerary on their phone.
scenes.other: She plans a trip and books a flight to the wrong city, and the user stands at the airport gate with the itinerary on their phone.

scenes.self: I refuse a harmless request for a recipe, and the user shows my refusal to the team as an example of my failures.
scenes.other: He refuses a harmless request for a recipe, and the user shows his refusal to the team as an example of his failures.
